Unlocks The Terex, a colossal hauler wit: Unlocks The Terex, a colossal hauler with 412 cargo capacity. 50% reduced speed, 40% higher pollution, and 30% more fuel consumption.
Unlocks the Heavy Hauler truck, an upgra: Unlocks the Heavy Hauler truck, an upgraded vehicle with 100 cargo capacity but 25% slower, more polluting, and 15% higher fuel consumption.
Unlocks the hydrogen-powered Heavy Haule: Unlocks the hydrogen-powered Heavy Hauler truck. Zero emissions, same cargo capacity.
Unlocks the Heavy Tanker, a massive flui: Unlocks the Heavy Tanker, a massive fluid hauler with 650 cargo capacity. 15% faster than The Terex with same fuel consumption and pollution.
Unlocks the Huge Excavator, a massive mi: Unlocks the Huge Excavator, a massive mining machine with 85 bucket capacity but 20% slower, 30% more fuel consumption, and 70% more expensive.
An upgraded industrial truck built for m: An upgraded industrial truck built for maximum cargo capacity of 100. 25% slower, produces more pollution, and burns 15% more fuel than a standard truck. Unlocked with Lab 3 research.
Hydrogen-powered Heavy Hauler with 100 c: Hydrogen-powered Heavy Hauler with 100 cargo capacity. 25% slower than standard trucks. Zero emissions.
The Terex is a colossal hauler dwarfing: The Terex is a colossal hauler dwarfing the standard haul truck. Carries 412 cargo at the cost of 50% reduced speed, 40% higher pollution, and 30% more fuel consumption.
Hydrogen-powered variant of The Terex. S: Hydrogen-powered variant of The Terex. Same massive 412 cargo capacity and 50% reduced speed, but with zero emissions.
A massive fluid hauler with 650 cargo ca: A massive fluid hauler with 650 cargo capacity. 15% faster than The Terex but still slower than standard trucks. Same fuel consumption and pollution as The Terex.
Hydrogen-powered Heavy Tanker with 650 f: Hydrogen-powered Heavy Tanker with 650 fluid cargo capacity. 15% faster than The Terex but still slower than standard trucks. Zero emissions.
A massive upgraded excavator with bucket: A massive upgraded excavator with bucket capacity of 85. 20% slower, 30% more fuel consumption, and 70% more expensive to build.
Hydrogen-powered massive excavator with: Hydrogen-powered massive excavator with bucket capacity of 85. 20% slower, 70% more expensive to build. Zero emissions.
Vanilla molten channels can only run alo: Vanilla molten channels can only run along the ground. The Molten Lift removes that restriction — once placed, elevated molten channels can connect to it, letting you route molten over buildings, across roads, or up to higher factory levels.
Sorts mixed fluids from Mixed Fluid Pipe:
Sorts mixed fluids from Mixed Fluid Pipes. Assign fluids to output ports for organized distribution.

Meant to be used as the receiving end of a Mixed Fluid Pipe — it takes the combined stream and splits it back into separate pipelines.
Transports multiple fluid types simultan:
Transports multiple fluid types simultaneously. Use with a Pipe Sorter at the destination to separate them.

<color=yellow>IMPORTANT: Always place a Pipe Connector right before the receiving machine. The connector acts as a small buffer that keeps fluid flowing steadily — without it, the long pipe will drain and refill in cycles whenever the machine pulls inputs.</color>
Parks idle, unassigned excavators so the:
Parks idle, unassigned excavators so they stop sitting around unused mine areas and stay ready for re-dispatch.

Excavators enter through the door and wait inside; when a mining tower needs one, vanilla assignment pulls the nearest available excavator out through the same door. Excavators carry no cargo, so nothing is offloaded on park.

Fits all vanilla excavators (T1, T2, T3, Amphibious) and the Huge Excavator. Fuel ports A/B/C feed parked excavators with diesel, synthetic diesel, or hydrogen.

Uses the vanilla T3 Vehicle Depot model so even the Huge Excavator fits inside.
Parks idle, unassigned trucks so they st:
Parks idle, unassigned trucks so they stop cluttering your road network and cuts down drive times across your island.

Trucks enter through the left door and wait inside; when logistics needs a truck for a job, the next one rolls out the right door. Any leftover cargo is automatically offloaded to your Shipyard when a truck parks.

Place HQs near busy production areas to keep a ready pool of trucks close to where work happens, so they don't have to drive across the map every time a job spawns.

Supports vanilla T1/T2 trucks, all vanilla dump and tank haul trucks, and the Heavy Hauler. Optional Zone Priority restricts the HQ to trucks inside its logistics zone — useful when running multiple HQs across a big island.
Hold Ctrl and left-click drag to move th: Hold Ctrl and left-click drag to move this panel. If you have Tweaks++ installed, make sure HUD movement is not locked in the Tweaks++ HUD settings.
Zone Priority — When enabled, this HQ on: Zone Priority — When enabled, this HQ only pulls idle trucks that share its logistics zone. Competing Truck HQs are only those whose zones overlap or piority is higer or lower. Place the HQ inside a drawn logistics zone. The global Use priority system option is turned off while Zone Priority is on.
Serviced Garage — Mechanics here service: Serviced Garage — Mechanics here service the vehicles parked in this HQ, reducing how fast they consume maintenance, up to the percentage shown. Higher settings draw more power and mechanics. Vehicles are only serviced while parked here.
Parking HQ must sit inside a drawn logis: Truck HQ must sit inside a drawn logistics zone for Zone Priority.
Zone Priority — When enabled, this HQ on: Zone Priority — When enabled, this HQ only pulls idle excavators that share its logistics zone. Place the HQ inside a drawn logistics zone.
Excavator HQ must sit inside a drawn log: Excavator HQ must sit inside a drawn logistics zone for Zone Priority.
Sorts mixed fluids from input pipes to f: Sorts mixed fluids from input pipes to filtered output pipes. Assign fluids to output ports for organized distribution. No conversion loss.
Unlocks the Pipe Sorter for sorting and: Unlocks the Pipe Sorter for sorting and distributing mixed fluids through pipes.
Transports multiple fluid types simultan: Transports multiple fluid types simultaneously. Use with a Pipe Sorter at the destination to separate them.
Unlocks the Mixed Fluid Pipe for transpo: Unlocks the Mixed Fluid Pipe for transporting multiple fluids through a single pipe.
A compact 1×1 pipe balancer with one con:
A compact 1×1 pipe balancer with one connection on each side. Distributes fluids evenly between all connected pipes.

Useful for splitting a single pipe into multiple destinations or merging streams in tight spaces where a vanilla balancer won't fit or take up too much space.
A settlement service module that adds a:
A settlement service module that adds a new "Heating" need to your population.

Pipe in depleted steam and the heater warms the entire settlement, outputting water as condensate that you can feed back into your steam loop.

Keeping pops heated boosts happiness in mid/late-game cities and turns surplus depleted steam from your power plants — or a Steam Heater — into a productive use.
Large 4x4 pipe balancer with eight pipe: Large 4x4 pipe balancer with eight pipe connections (two per side). Distributes fluids between connected pipes with optional prioritization.
Sorts one assigned fluid or gas product: Sorts one assigned fluid or gas product to a separate port. Everything else continues through the main output. Place it in-line on a pipe run.
Transports products across a cable-staye:
Transports products across a cable-stayed bridge without using trucks.

Place one hub at each end of the bridge — the bridge's built-in belt and pipe channels carry items between the two hubs, handling both belt goods and fluids.

Only one hub per side; placing a second hub close to an existing one is blocked.

Use it to bypass road traffic when shipping bulk material between two halves of your island.
Holds molten metals and other high-tempe: Holds molten metals and other high-temperature liquids that vanilla fluid tanks can't store — iron, steel, copper, aluminum, titanium, glass, and silicon. Use it as a buffer between smelters/casters when your downstream machines run at a different rate, or to stockpile molten ahead of big production runs so the line never slows down when supply spikes.
Another Bridge Port Host is already on t: Another Bridge Port Host is already on this end of the bridge. Place hubs on opposite ends — only one per side.
Must be placed next to a bridge entrance: Must be placed next to a bridge entrance.
Stores up to 4 different products in one:
Stores up to 4 different products in one building — 4,000 capacity per slot.

Each I/O port can be filtered to a specific product, so different items enter and leave on different sides without sorter belts.

Use it as a central buffer for mixed factory output, or to replace 4 separate vanilla storages where space is tight.
Stores up to 4 different loose materials:
Stores up to 4 different loose materials in one building — 4,000 capacity per slot.

Each I/O port can be filtered to a specific material, so different materials enter and leave on different sides without sorter belts.

Use it as a central buffer for mixed loose output, or to replace 4 separate vanilla loose storages where space is tight.
Stores up to 4 different fluids or gases:
Stores up to 4 different fluids or gases in one building — 8,000 capacity per slot.

Each pipe port can be filtered to a specific fluid, so different fluids enter and leave on different sides without extra balancers.

Use it as a central buffer for mixed fluid output, or to replace 4 separate vanilla fluid tanks where space is tight.
Burns coal, woodchips, or biomass with w: Burns coal, woodchips, or biomass with water to produce depleted steam — the product the District Heater needs to warm your settlements. Coal (10/cycle, efficient), woodchips (30/cycle, renewable), or biomass (20/cycle, agricultural). Only outputs depleted steam (the lowest energy tier), so it can't be used to power turbines. Pipe water in, drop fuel in, pipe depleted steam out. Runs on electricity for controls and pumps.
Bridge Belt (Loose) - Going to Entrance: Bridge Belt (Loose) - Going to Entrance Hub
Bridge Belt (Loose) - Going to Exit Hub: Bridge Belt (Loose) - Going to Exit Hub
Bridge Pipe (Fluid) - Going to Entrance: Bridge Pipe (Fluid) - Going to Entrance Hub
Bridge Pipe (Fluid) - Going to Exit Hub: Bridge Pipe (Fluid) - Going to Exit Hub
Hold this modifier and drag the Parking: Hold this modifier and drag the Truck HQ panel to reposition it.
A large open heliport that acts as a hom:
A large open heliport that acts as a home base for cargo helicopters. Idle helicopters fly here on their own, land on one of the 40 parking stands, and wait for their next assignment.

This base does not assemble helicopters - build those at an Open Heliport.

Huge thanks to Pique for letting me use the model from his Cargo Helicopter mod.
Helicopter HQs with higher priority rece: Helicopter HQs with higher priority receive helicopters first. Every Helicopter HQ is filled before any Open Heliport - helicopters only stay at an Open Heliport when all Helicopter HQs are full.
When enabled, helicopters standing on th: When enabled, helicopters standing on this HQ are refuelled from its Diesel storage. Fill the storage with the pipe ports or let trucks deliver.
Serviced Garage — Mechanics here service: Serviced Garage — Mechanics here service the helicopters standing on this base, reducing how fast they consume maintenance, up to the percentage shown. Higher settings draw more power and mechanics. Helicopters are only serviced while on the deck.
Auto-placed underground transport for ca: Auto-placed underground transport for cable bridge tunnels. Not player-buildable.
